title: Fix silent catches in MemorySmith.App controllers (Admin/Search/OAuthBridge/Health)
description: Audit found silent catch blocks and swallowing of exceptions in MemorySmith.App controllers which hides failures and violates Rule E-3. Files: MemorySmith.App/Controllers/AdminController.cs, MemorySmith.App/Controllers/SearchController.cs, MemorySmith.App/Controllers/OAuthBridgeController.cs, MemorySmith.App/Controllers/HealthController.cs. Action: add structured logging (`ILogger`) and replace bare `catch {}` with `logger.LogWarning(ex, ...)` or appropriate error handling. Out-of-scope for MemorySmith.Agent — assign to MemorySmith.App maintainers.
